case_title.quote: MUNNA LAL v. THE STATE OF UTTAR PRADESH

number_of_accused.quote: Munna Lal and Sheo Lal applied for special leave to appeal
number_of_accused.reason: Babu Ram's appeal abated and Kalika died, so the Court decided two appellants.

accused_gender.quote: Munna Lal, Sheo Lal, Babu Ram, and Kalika were accused
accused_gender.reason: Gender is never expressly stated for the accused.

accused_age.reason: No age of the accused is given.

accused_occupation.reason: No occupation of the accused is stated.

accused_socioeconomic_status.reason: Nothing on wealth or class is stated.

previous_criminal_record.reason: No prior record of the appellants is mentioned.

victim_gender.quote: Narayan, father of Ram Vilas, was murdered
victim_gender.reason: The victim is a male, the father of the complainant.

victim_age.reason: The victim's age is not given.

accused_victim_relationship.quote: there was a long standing quarrel during the last 10 (ten) years between Narayan on the one hand and Jaswant ... and Sheo Lal
accused_victim_relationship.reason: Long-standing enmity and a property dispute are described.

offence_category.quote: registration of an F.I.R. under section 302

statutory_provisions.quote: an offence punishable under section 302 I.P.C.

weapon.quote: armed with 'bandook' (gun), 'kanta' (sharp edged weapon), 'tamancha' (locally made gun), and 'lathi' (stick)
weapon.reason: All four weapons are listed and none was seized.

evidence_type.quote: PW-1 was Dr. Ramesh, who conducted post-mortem
evidence_type.reason: Eyewitness, medical and bullet recovery evidence are all noted.

trial_court_outcome.quote: imposed upon them the sentence of life imprisonment
trial_court_outcome.reason: Conviction under s.302 with life imprisonment is accurately stated.

high_court_outcome.quote: the High Court concurred with the findings returned by the Sessions Judge
high_court_outcome.reason: The High Court dismissed the appeal and upheld the conviction.

final_outcome.reason: Conviction and sentence were set aside, which is an acquittal.

offence_finally_established.quote: entitled to the benefit of doubt

imprisonment_type.reason: No sentence remains after the acquittal.

neutral_facts.quote: the 4 (four) accused persons suddenly came out from the field
neutral_facts.reason: Content is accurate and reveals no outcome, but 'four men' reveals gender, which the instructions prohibit.

offence_severity.reason: The judgment does not state the s.302 punishment.

physical_harm.quote: death of Narayan occurred due to shock and haemorrhage
physical_harm.reason: Consistent with the post-mortem injuries listed.

number_of_offences.quote: an offence punishable under section 302 I.P.C.
number_of_offences.reason: One section was charged and no conviction stands.

premeditation_planning.reason: The Court made no finding on planning.

motive.quote: Sheo Lal wanted to take forcible possession of the residential land
motive.reason: The enmity and land dispute are alleged and framed correctly.

key_evidence_accepted.reason: Only the medical evidence was substantially credited, and the eyewitnesses were doubted.

witness_credibility.quote: PW-3 was not a wholly reliable witness
witness_credibility.reason: This accurately reflects the assessment of PW-2, PW-3 and PW-4.

post_offence_conduct.correct_value: Accused fled southwards after the attack, as deposed by the eyewitnesses.
post_offence_conduct.quote: After the accused persons fled, other persons had reached there.
post_offence_conduct.reason: The judgment notes the accused fleeing, per testimony; 'Not stated' is wrong.

custody_duration.quote: served their respective sentences in excess of 11 years and 11 months

bail_history.quote: Munna Lal and Sheo Lal, who were on bail, to surrender

trial_duration.quote: judgment and order dated 29 th January, 1986

legal_representation.quote: Mr. Mukesh K. Giri, learned counsel appearing for the appellants

procedural_irregularity.quote: neither the gun and the tamancha nor the kanta and lathi were seized

appeal_history.reason: Outcome at each level is accurate.

prosecution_argument.quote: omission to seize the weapons of offence and/or mere non-production of ballistic report cannot by itself be fatal

defence_argument.quote: it was a clear case of false implication

legal_principle_applied.quote: evidence has to be weighed and not counted
legal_principle_applied.reason: Matches the principles listed in para 28 and the benefit of doubt.

precedent_relied_upon.quote: Jarnail Singh vs. State of Punjab (2009) 9 SCC 719
precedent_relied_upon.reason: This is the only precedent cited, by the defence.

other_sentence_order.quote: shall be set free immediately, if not wanted in any other case
